overview: This table tells the game whether each relationship between two story characters appears friendly or hostile at each relationship level.
description: Defines the five per-level friendly/hostile presentation flags for a directed StoryCharaGraphPair relationship; consumed by relationship UI to choose labels, gauge/target backgrounds, and graph-line styling.

ID.simple: The name that links this relationship to two story characters in a specific order.
ID.technical: FName export/import key and UDataTable row name in StoryCharaRelateLevelDataTables (DTM +0x880); all 88 exported rows have ID equal to their row key. StoryCharaGraphPair.Id_StoryCharaRelateLevel[partner index] supplies the lookup name, so order matters: A_B and B_A are separate rows. The gauge, graph, target-item, level-change and earned-reward consumers use UDataTable::FindRow through DTM_FindStoryCharaRelateLevelRow (retail 0x1649650) or the equivalent FindFirstRow template; both walk tables in order and return the first match. Traced callers pass bCheckNone=false and the unused bUnknown=false, so NAME_None is not rejected up front and lookup results are read unchecked. The native Id member is not itself read by the traced consumers; export Properties.ImportKeyField is Id.

bFriendly.simple: Sets whether each of the five relationship levels appears friendly or hostile in story screens. Switching one on shows the friendly label and visuals for that level.
bFriendly.technical: TArray<bool> of five flags, indexed as [Level - 1] for levels 1..5. Level comes from GameManager::GetCharaRelateLevel or the change preview: StoryCharaGraphPair.StartRelateLevel is converted to a value with GlobalThreshold Min (STORY_CHARA_RELATE_LV_1..5), the saved directed delta is added, and the result is converted back to a level. The flag selects SYS_STORY_CORRELATION_DIAGRAM_LABEL_0004 versus 0005, which gauge image is visible, which graph-line parameter list is used, and which target-item background is visible. GaugeRate is a unitless Change / (EndValue - StartValue) written to both gauge dynamic materials regardless of the flag. StartRelateLevel and EndRelateLevel are level numbers, not indices into this array; EndRelateLevel is used elsewhere for the gauge denominator and reward visibility, not to choose the flag. Every exported array has five booleans and no sentinel/default entry; consumers do not bounds-check Level or array length, so Level 0 or greater than 5 gives an out-of-range index, and a missing row is dereferenced unchecked. The graph widget separately guards its own five-element line-parameter lists but not this row.

notes: The row stores no numeric relation value, threshold, level count, or default/sentinel. All 88 exported rows have exactly five booleans. GlobalThreshold STORY_CHARA_RELATE_LV_1..5 have bands 0-24, 25-49, 50-74, 75-99 and 100-100, but the traced conversion functions use only the Min values [0, 25, 50, 75, 100] and cap derived levels at 5 (Source/Abrams/Private/GamePhase_WidgetTest.cpp:288-321). Shipped GraphPair start levels are 1..3 and exported change values are positive, but the C++ itself does not enforce the valid index range.

Row constructor is empty (Source/AbramsDataTable/Private/GameDataTableRow_StoryCharaRelateLevel.cpp:3). The single export StoryCharaRelateLevelDataTable.json has 88 unique row keys, every row ID equals its key, every bFriendly array has five booleans, and there are no shards, locale variants or None-ID rows in the available exports.

The friendly/hostile flag is presentation only: the numeric level is derived from StoryCharaGraphPair.StartRelateLevel, GlobalThreshold Min values, and the directed save-data delta in StudioNestedNameInts_770. StoryCharaRelateChange rows feed that delta (Source/Abrams/Private/GameManagerGraphics.cpp:476-489 and :531-549).

Rows are directed: consumers look up a GraphPair row by the source character and index by the other character, so A_B and B_A are distinct. The export has 44 reciprocal pairs; four have different five-flag arrays (for example CP_020_CP_030 versus CP_030_CP_020), so symmetry must not be assumed.

StoryCharaGraphPair.Id_Character and Id_StoryCharaRelateLevel contain None padding for absent partners in some rows. Target-list setup filters Partner.IsNone() before creating items (Source/Abrams/Private/GameStoryCharaRelateWidget.cpp:141), while other consumers use Find results and pair arrays unchecked.

DataTableManager registers the primary asset name StoryCharaRelateLevelDataTable, waits for all loaders, resolves that asset and appends it to the single DTM +0x880 table array; null tables are skipped (Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:266, :439 and :162). With one exported table the first-match precedence is currently trivial.

Evidence is from the reconstructed C++ in Source/: status/ records a mix of INV byte matches, BEHAV and EQUIV support for the cited functions, but this file does not claim a retail byte comparison for every function or exhaustive Blueprint/runtime coverage. No retail Blueprint graph or live-game result was inspected here; AGENTS.md states that shipped gameplay logic is C++, but widget bindings and material setup are not independently verified.

usages.detail: Pair row supplies the level-row ID; bFriendly selects the visible friendly/hostile gauge image and the relation label. The GaugeRate ratio is written to both gauge dynamic materials regardless of the flag.
Uses GameManager level and bFriendly to select FriendlyRelateLevelLineParameterList[Level - 1] or HostileRelateLevelLineParameterList[Level - 1] for a graph edge.

Uses the directed pair row for CharacterId -> TargetCharacterId and bFriendly[ToLevel - 1] to choose Background_Friendry or Background_Hostility; target list items are fed by GameStoryCharaRelateWidget::SetupTargetList.
Uses bFriendly[NewLevel - 1] for the friendly/hostile relation label after a change, in both directions (Source/Abrams/Private/GameCharaRelateLevelListItemWidget.cpp:103-104).
Uses bFriendly[Game->GetCharaRelateLevel(From, To) - 1] for the earned-reward list relation labels in both directions.

Loads/resolves StoryCharaRelateLevelDataTable through the primary-asset loader map and caches it in StoryCharaRelateLevelDataTables (DTM +0x880); also registered at Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:439.

Indirect consumer: GetCharaRelateLevel supplies the level used by the graph, target and reward consumers from GraphPair start level plus saved delta and GlobalThreshold conversion; it does not read this table directly.
Indirect consumer: StoryRelationLevel/StoryRelationValue convert GlobalThreshold Min values into the 1..5 Level used to index bFriendly.
